picks.what: The walled town, detail of a painted map of the Schwarzenberg estates
picks.why: bird’s-eye drawing of the walled town with the Black Tower and St. Nicholas; only pre-1800 view
general view with the Black Tower, cathedral and synagogue; caption trimmed off

gaps: P0, P1: no candidates; P3: only a distant landscape (#2); P5: only vertical 1945 reconnaissance photos; P6: no view of the historic center (only distant views from surrounding villages)
notes: #1 is low resolution (1100 px) and a map detail, but drawn as a view with the buildings. #3 is a folding postcard with a faint crease near the middle. #2 (Eduard Gurk, 1840) shows Budweis only as a thin silhouette on the horizon behind the Rudolfov church, so I left it out; it could fill P3 with focal about [0.7, 0.5] if a distant view is acceptable. #4 (Erwin Spindler, color postcard of the main square with the Black Tower) is better looking than #3, but its date is only the artist’s lifespan (1860–1926); it is probably about 1900.
